name: Game Server Live Bridge
description: Live status monitoring, bidirectional chat relay, and secure console RCON commands for Minecraft, Rust, and Source game servers.
author: Cillhub examples

settings.label: Server Type
settings.description: Game server engine or protocol type.

settings.label: Server Hostname
settings.description: Hostname or domain of the game server (e.g. mc.example.com).

settings.label: Server Port
settings.description: Game or RCON port (default 25565 for Minecraft, 28016 for Rust RCON).

settings.label: RCON Password
settings.description: Secret password used to authenticate console RCON commands.

settings.label: Chat Webhook Secret
settings.description: Shared secret the game server sends as "secret" when it posts chat to /modules/game-server-sync/http/chat. The bridge stays closed while it is empty.

settings.label: Status Embed Channel
settings.description: Channel where the live status embed is pinned and periodically updated.

settings.label: Chat Sync Channel
settings.description: Text channel bridged bidirectionally with in-game chat.

commands.name: rcon
commands.description: Execute a game server console command via secure RCON

options.name: command
options.description: Console command to run on the server

commands.name: gameserver
commands.description: View game server status and player list

options.name: status
options.description: Display live player count, latency, and online player list
